feat: add "Compare Commits" to pull request force-pushes (#15271)

Implements #5357.  Contains #15252 as a prerequisite.

When a force push occurs against an open pull request, it can be difficult for a reviewer to recognize what changed in a pull request.  The existing "Compare" button compares the source tree between the original head of the PR and the new head of the PR; if the force push contains both modifications to the pull request, and a rebase of the pull request, then both sets of changes are displayed because that represents the change between the commits.  The changes caused by the rebase are typically not relevant for a reviewer of the pull request.

Replaces the "Compare" button with "Compare Commits" and "Compare Tree".  Compare Tree performs the source tree comparison.  Compare Commits performs a `git range-diff` command which compares the commits that existed in the PR before the force-push with the commits that exist after the force-push, allowing changes to the PR to be observed separately of changes to the base branch.
